name: Ian Skailes
features: fair hair, lean face, quiet clubman's manner, medium build
bio: British privateer who ran the Chevron B16 in the 2-litre class in 1970, sharing it with John Hine at Le Mans, where the little Cosworth-engined coupe ran with the works Alfas and Porsches until the engine let go in the night. The class was where the B16 belonged: light, quick through the corners and cheap enough for a clubman to take to the 1000 km races.
